blocks.text: When your music is on, nothing else matters. The JBL Tune 770NC Adaptive Noise Cancelling wireless headphones deliver on that promise all day—and longer, while sparing you the unwanted noises. With up to 70 hours of battery life, you’ll easily get through a busy week of using them and still have enough JBL Pure Bass Sound to get you through the weekend. And if you do need a quick recharge, 5 minutes gets you an extra 3 hours of music. Lightweight, and flat-folding, the JBL Tune 770NC can also connect with two Bluetooth® devices simultaneously, so you’ll never miss a call while watching a movie on your tablet. With the free JBL Headphones app, you can tailor the sound to suit your taste. And voice prompts in your language will guide you through the features. Manage your calls and your voice assistant hassle-free right from your phone and use VoiceAware to hear yourself when you’re speaking. Just choose the color that best suits your vibe, and start having fun.

items.label: Adaptive Noise Cancelling with Smart Ambient
items.value: Adaptive Noise Cancelling means zero distractions whether you’re studying or getting lost in the music. If you want to hear the world around you, activate Ambient Aware and TalkThru in the JBL Headphones app.

items.label: Bluetooth 5.3 with LE Audio
items.value: Wirelessly stream high-quality JBL Pure Bass Sound. In the JBL Headphones app select Audio mode for the best sound quality or Video Mode to ensure the sound and visuals of your movie/game are in sync. *Available via OTA update

items.label: JBL Pure Bass Sound
items.value: JBL Tune 770NC headphones feature renowned JBL Pure Bass sound—the same that powers the most famous music venues all around the world.

items.label: Customize your listening experience
items.value: Download the free JBL Headphones App to tailor the sound to your taste by choosing one of the pre-set EQ modes or adjusting the EQ curve according to your content, your style, your taste.

items.label: Hands-free calls with VoiceAware
items.value: Easily control your sound and manage your calls from your headphones with the convenient buttons on the ear-cup. Hear your voice while you're talking, with the help of VoiceAware.
